text: The retrieved literature offers only limited direct evidence on interventions targeting detection of AI-generated content specifically. The closest prior findings concern interventions that improve general credibility or misinformation discernment: Bhuiyan et al. (2021) found that nudge-based design interventions on social media can shift users toward more credible news sources, suggesting that lightweight cues may alter overall discernment accuracy (relevant to H1). Roozenbeek et al. (2022) demonstrated that psychological inoculation improves resilience against misinformation, indicating that pre-bunking-style interventions can change how people evaluate the authenticity of content (relevant to H1 and H3). However, none of the retrieved works directly test whether such interventions differentially affect detection of AI-generated versus authentic content (H2 vs. H3), leaving a clear gap that the present study addresses.
